about.intro: I'm a Computer Science graduate with a concentration in Advanced Cybersecurity and a strong foundation in IT systems, networking, and database management. My current focus is on cybersecurity, with a particular interest in digital forensics and incident response.
about.bio: Previously, I worked as a IT Technician at Firebaugh Las Deltas Unified School District where I was able to gain a solid foundation in IT support, network administration, and system maintenance. In addition to my IT background, I have worked on several technical projects that reflect my growing expertise in cybersecurity. This includes deploying cloud-based infrastructure and managing SQL databases for a web application, as well as developing machine learning models for phishing detection. Through these projects, I have gained experience in secure system design, along with exposure to various tools and technologies commonly used in the cybersecurity field.

projects.title: Digital Forensics Image Analysis
projects.description: A digital forensics analysis project focusing on the analysis of files for evidence recovery. A forensic investigation report detailing the process of analyzing a file for evidence recovery, including the use of various forensic tools and techniques to extract and interpret data relevant to a hypothetical case study.

projects.title: Archivr - Media Recommendation
projects.description: Archivr is a website that serves a one-stop hub for tracking, rating, and discussing your favorite movies and TV. It allows you to share your thoughts, join discussions, and discover new favorites based on personalized recommendations.

projects.title: Phishing URL Detector
projects.description: A phishing URL detector that uses machine learning to analyze URLs and identify potential phishing threats. The model is trained on a dataset of known phishing and legitimate URLs, utilizing features such as URL length, presence of special characters, and domain age to make predictions.

projects.title: Hospital Network Design and Implementation - Packet Tracer
projects.description: Designed and implemented a secure network infrastructure for a hospital environment, incorporating VLAN segmentation, firewall rules, and intrusion detection systems to protect sensitive patient data and ensure compliance with healthcare regulations.

writing.title: Flag In Flame — Log File Analysis and Encoded Image Recovery
writing.description: A forensic investigation into a log file concealing a Base64-encoded JPEG image, followed by hexadecimal decoding to recover a hidden flag.

writing.title: Hidden In Plain Sight — Steganographic Analysis of a Concealed Payload
writing.description: A multi-layered forensic analysis combining EXIF metadata inspection, nested Base64 decoding, and steghide extraction to recover a hidden flag from a JPEG image.

writing.title: Log Hunt — Log File Analysis and Encoded Image Recovery
writing.description: Forensic analysis of a log file used as a Base64-encoded image carrier, with hex-encoded flag recovery from the reconstructed image.

writing.title: Riddle Registry — Metadata Forensics and Encoded Artifact Recovery from a PDF
writing.description: Structured forensic inspection of a PDF file using integrity verification, string analysis, and metadata examination to recover a Base64-encoded flag from the Author field.

writing.title: Enhanced Facial Detection: Age and Mask Identification for Diverse Applications
writing.description: A report on building a real-time facial analysis system using deep learning to estimate age and detect mask usage. Integrated trained CNN models into a live web app, achieving over 94% accuracy in mask detection.

writing.title: Detecting Phishing Website: A Deep Learning Approach with MLP
writing.description: A deep learning–based approach to detecting phishing websites using a Multilayer Perceptron, achieving high accuracy through feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning. This report highlights the model’s effectiveness in identifying malicious URLs while minimizing false positives and negatives.
writing.url: /resume/Detecting PhishingWebsites A Deep Learning Approach with MLP.pdf

writing.title: Wireshark Lab: Ethernet & ARP Protocol Analysis
writing.description: Packet-level analysis of Ethernet frame addressing and the ARP request/reply cycle, examining how devices resolve IP addresses to MAC addresses at the data link layer.

writing.title: Wireshark Lab: IP Protocol & Fragmentation Analysis
writing.description: Analysis of IPv4 datagram headers and fragmentation behavior using traceroute captures, examining which header fields change across hops and how oversized datagrams are split to fit link MTUs.

writing.title: Wireshark Lab: TCP Protocol Analysis
writing.description: Examination of a TCP file upload capture covering the three-way handshake, sequence/acknowledgment numbering, flow control, and slow start congestion behavior.

writing.title: Wireshark Lab: HTTP Protocol Analysis
writing.description: Investigation of HTTP GET/response cycles, conditional caching, multi-segment responses, embedded object retrieval, and HTTP Basic Authentication via live packet captures.
